events.title: Galerius issues an edict ending the persecution of Christians
events.description: Gravely ill, Emperor Galerius granted Christians the right to worship, ending the Great Persecution in his territories. He died days later; Constantine's Edict of Milan followed in 313.
events.html: Gravely ill, Emperor Galerius granted Christians the right to worship, ending the Great Persecution in his territories. He died days later; Constantine's Edict of Milan followed in 313.

events.title: Ferdinand and Isabella confirm Columbus's titles
events.description: At Granada the monarchs granted Columbus the titles of admiral, viceroy and governor of any lands he found, and ordered Palos to provide ships. He sailed in August.
events.html: At Granada the monarchs granted Columbus the titles of admiral, viceroy and governor of any lands he found, and ordered Palos to provide ships. He sailed in August.

events.title: George Washington is inaugurated as first US president
events.description: Washington took the oath of office on the balcony of Federal Hall in New York. His conduct in office set precedents, such as the two-term tradition, that shaped the presidency.
events.html: Washington took the oath of office on the balcony of Federal Hall in New York. His conduct in office set precedents, such as the two-term tradition, that shaped the presidency.

events.title: Louisiana Purchase treaty doubles the size of the United States
events.description: American envoys in Paris agreed to buy France's Louisiana territory for $15 million. The deal, dated this day, gave the young republic the vast basin west of the Mississippi.
events.html: American envoys in Paris agreed to buy France's Louisiana territory for $15 million. The deal, dated this day, gave the young republic the vast basin west of the Mississippi.

events.title: Adolf Hitler takes his own life in Berlin
events.description: With Soviet troops closing in, Hitler shot himself in his bunker beneath the Reich Chancellery. Germany surrendered unconditionally a week later.
events.html: With Soviet troops closing in, Hitler shot himself in his bunker beneath the Reich Chancellery. Germany surrendered unconditionally a week later.

events.title: Saigon falls to North Vietnamese forces
events.description: Tanks broke through the gates of the presidential palace hours after the last Americans were lifted out by helicopter. The war ended and Vietnam was reunified under communist rule in 1976.
